in_hebrew.name: Adeodatus
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Adeodatus הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Latin word 'Deus' meaning 'God' and 'Datus' meaning 'given'. The name Adeodatus means 'God-given'. In Christian tradition, the name symbolizes the belief in God's divine intervention and guidance in one's life.

in_greek.long_meaning: Adeodatus είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. From the Latin word 'Deus' meaning 'God' and 'Datus' meaning 'given'. The name Adeodatus means 'God-given'. In Christian tradition, the name symbolizes the belief in God's divine intervention and guidance in one's life.

in_latin.name: Adeodatus
in_latin.meaning: Name meaning God-given, gift of God, or God is a gift
in_latin.long_meaning: Adeodatus est nomen quod significat donum Dei, datum a Deo aut Deus est donum. Nomina similis, ut Deus, sunt communia in multarum linguarum culturis et religiosis traditionibus. Adeodatus est Latinum nomen, ab a- (nihil) et deus (Deus), signum quod Deus non dedit, donum a Deo datum. In Christiana traditione, nomen Adeodatus designat donum a Deo, gratiam a Deo datam. Nomen est usitatum in Ecclesia Catholica et in cultura Christiana. In contextu scripturali, nomen Adeodatus non est expressum, sed significatio eius est manifesta in scripturis sacris, ubi Deus est donum a Deo datum hominibus.
